headline: Bids for a $12,093,967 TSA checkpoint at the airport, a $273,902 tandem axle plow truck, and four other purchases.
summary: The committee will review six bids for vehicles and equipment, including trucks, a hydroseeder, a compressor, and light fixtures. Two items, the tandem axle plow truck and the TSA checkpoint, are recommended to go to the full council.
items: Two ¾ Ton Trucks for Parks & Recreation from Darling's Ford, $110,173 (committee approval)
Hydroseeder for Public Works from Hydrograss Corp, $57,984 (committee approval)
Compressor for Public Works from Technology International Inc., $25,179 (committee approval)
Decorative Light Fixtures for Public Works from Coastal Traffic Inc., $67,886 (committee approval)
Tandem Axle Plow Truck for Public Works from Freightliner of Maine, $273,902 (committee recommendation to full council)
TSA Checkpoint for the Airport from Sheridan, $12,093,967 (committee recommendation to full council)

OTHER COMMENTS:
Airport staff is requesting Finance Committee approval to award this bid to Sheridan Corporation, Fairfield, ME. 
Three bids were received from Optimum Construction, Devoe Construction, and Sheridan Corporation.
Based on the submitted bid schedules, Sheridan Corporation is the low bidder for this project. Airport staff and 
the design team have reviewed the proposal and Sheridan's proposal has been deemed complete and 
responsive.
Funding for this project will come from Passenger Facility Charges (PFC) in the amount of $12,281,179 and 
budgeted Airport funds in the amout of $650,461.
Sheridan Corporation has a positive history with the City and the airport. Airport staff will be at the meeting to 
answer any further questions.
